d:
Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary’s remarks on “crime” and “apradh” have gone viral on social media. His statement has sparked a political controversy, with the Opposition questioning what exactly the Chief Minister meant. The viral video has led to a debate over his choice of words while talking about crime in Bihar. The Opposition has also targeted Samrat Chaudhary over the statement and raised questions about the state’s law and order situation.
So, what did Samrat Chaudhary actually say, why did his remarks become controversial, and what has the Opposition said?
